name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on detergents and surfactants, amending Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 and repealing Regulation (EC) No 648/2004
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved the Council's position on a new law on detergents and surfactants. This replaces the old 2004 detergents regulation and updates another 2019 regulation. The report itself does not list the detailed rule changes. It confirms that Parliament and the Council reached an agreement in earlier negotiations, and Parliament voted to accept it without further amendments. The law is now set to be formally signed and published.

- **What changes:** The 2004 detergents regulation is repealed and replaced by new rules on detergents and surfactants.
- **Who it affects:** Companies making or selling detergents and surfactants in the EU.
- **What happens next:** The act is signed and published in the Official Journal.
